Message.Name: Index Definition Message
Message.Description: The Index Definition message contains the static referential data for the given index and is generated at the start of the business day. May be re-disseminated during trading hours.

Field.Name: IndexCode
Field.Description: Upstream source's index code or market information identifier.

Field.Name: IndexSource
Field.Description: Index or market information source.

Field.Name: CurrencyCode
Field.Description: Currency code of Index Turnover. Can be blank if not defined by third party index compilers.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Message.Name: Index Data Message
Message.Description: The Index Data message contains all the real-time data for a given index. Fields may be populated with null values to indicate when an update is not provided.

Field.Name: IndexCode
Field.Description: Upstream source's index code or market information identifier.

Field.Name: IndexStatus
Field.Description: Index status. Can be blank if not defined by third party index compilers.

Field.Name: IndexTime
Field.Description: Publisher timestamp. Nanoseconds since Unix epoch UTC, precision to the nearest second.

Field.Name: IndexValue
Field.Description: Current value of the index. 4 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: NetChgPrevDay
Field.Description: Net change of IndexValue from the previous close, as provided in index source. 4 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: HighValue
Field.Description: Highest value for an index. 4 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: LowValue
Field.Description: Lowest value for an index. 4 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: EASValue
Field.Description: Estimated Average Settlement Value. 2 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: IndexTurnover
Field.Description: Current turnover of underlying constituents. 4 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: OpeningValue
Field.Description: First value for an index. 4 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: ClosingValue
Field.Description: Last value for an index. 4 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: PreviousSesClose
Field.Description: Previous session closing value (previous day for CSI, CES, S&P; previous session for HSI and TR). 4 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: IndexVolume
Field.Description: Index volume of underlying constituents. Only applicable for CSI and CES.

Field.Name: NetChgPrevDayPct
Field.Description: Percentage change of IndexValue from the previous close. 4 implied decimal places.

Field.Name: Exception
Field.Description: Exception indicator.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: Padding.

Value.Name: Index with HSIL defined exceptional rule applied
